properties.citation: M. Bougma, AIDELF, 2014, d’après les recensements ; fond Natural Earth, domaine public: zones approximatives où chaque langue est la plus parlée ; presque toutes les régions parlent plusieurs langues (recensements de 1985 à 2006). Provenance of the card bfa-03: Beat 3. Zones placed by administrative region from Bougma 2014 (censuses 1985–2006): sources/records/bougma-2014.md. Ellipses drawn from region extents (lat/lon of the regions named in the source), not traced from a map. Ordinance 84-043/CNR/PRES du 2 août 1984 in the voice and the caption.
properties.derivation: Built by social/video/areas.mjs: the ellipse « fulfulde (Fulɓe) » of the card bfa-03, in the card units of afrique-ouest.json (equirectangular, 19 px a degree, origin 19° W 30° N), each cubic segment sampled 8 times and rounded to 0.01°. The research drew it from the extent of the regions the source names; it marks where the language is most spoken, not a limit.
